title: Shifted Roos map induced by a commuting square
statement: Let $A$ be an abelian category with countable products and use the strict Roos product $B_X$, endomorphism $u_X=1-t_X$, shifted cone $H(X)$ and its coordinates from [def-weil-strict-roos-model]. For complexes $X,Y$ of strict towers, cochain maps $a,b:B_X\to B_Y$, and a commuting square $a u_Y=u_X b$ (composition written left to right), define $H(a,b):H(X)\to H(Y)$ to be the map of the actual cones induced by that square, shifted by $-1$. In the degree-$(p+1)$ coordinates $B_X^p\oplus B_X^{p+1}$, it is the diagonal map with entries $b^p,a^{p+1}$. In particular, for $e\ge1$, the selection $a_e$ and finite-block map $b_e$ of [def-sp-strict-tower-arithmetic-restriction-data] satisfy the square by finite telescoping, and define this same cone map for arithmetic restriction. This records the existing strictRoosMapOfSquare construction and its existing coordinate and telescoping lemmas; it introduces no additive-functor comparison isomorphism.
